principal.name: Ingolf Lohmann
principal.role: declared Product Owner and original author

authority.effective_revision_rule: Resolve the current ref and verify its commit SHA; this historical source baseline is not a live HEAD assertion.

purpose: Discover primary sources, validate provenance and epistemic boundaries, and select an authorized, separately verified terminal or transputer path.

non_transfer: A published research model is not deployment conformance.
Lean theorem statements require kernel-checked proofs; a model proof is not implementation refinement.
64 characters is not a SHA-256 digest, nor is a digest evidence truth.
CI PASS is not host, DNS, TLS, peer or target-effect acceptance.
A received terminal input is not execution, merge, publication or production effect.
A Zenodo deposit is not peer review or IETF standardization.
No evidence crosses commit HEADs, PRs, subjects, or systems without independent binding.

read_only.prerequisite: Reachable original public source; verify commit, file identity, provenance, and file-specific licenses.
read_only.authentication: Only where the actual target contract requires it.

effect_path.authentication: Actual admitted Owner principal and target-scoped credentials only
effect_path.authorization: Never infer from source access, membership, model proof or owner declaration alone
effect_path.ambiguous_commit: Read back same original request before attempting any further effect

publication.policy: Stage separately versioned manuscript, machine manifest, human guide, provenance and license mapping; preserve originals.

destinations.name: Zenodo
destinations.next: Confirm deposit scope, exact file manifest, hashes, author rights, metadata and DOI; create deposit and verify public DOI readback

destinations.name: IETF
destinations.next: Determine if a protocol revision is actually needed; human editorial review and submit separately; verify datatracker revision

destinations.name: Other media
destinations.next: Only publish after license, accessibility, canonical linking and independent readback

publication.license_rule: Check each original file license; do not treat the corpus as uniformly licensed or imply rights transfer.
publication.preservation: Immutable version IDs and digests, stable DOI where available, migration-safe canonical pointers, correction history and successor links.
publication.publish_authorization: Owner instruction permits preparation and publication workflow; platform admission, third-party rights and final exact target remain separate gates.
